Tucker Carlson frames the fate of truck drivers as a sign of a larger American decline. A former trucker joins him to tell that story firsthand. Driving was once the most common job for men without college degrees.

Carlson argues that hostile policy has crushed people who did nothing wrong. The guest describes gang heists and trafficking routes on the highways. They link driver shortages to plots that steal work from citizens. The episode mixes road crime tales with a broad claim: a nation that harms its truckers harms itself.
